name: D4RL
description: D4RL is a benchmark suite of datasets specifically designed for offline reinforcement learning. It includes datasets generated by hand-designed controllers, human demonstrators, multi-objective tasks, and mixtures of policies, enabling evaluation of offline RL algorithms on realistic and diverse data.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by task; often near expert on some tasks and far lower on harder ones
reputation: D4RL is a widely used offline reinforcement learning benchmark suite and a standard reference point for comparing offline RL methods.
notes: Focuses on offline RL with static datasets to facilitate research on real-world applicable RL methods.
